sources.notes: Source describes spear-shaped calcite dogtooth spar lining limestone pockets. Actual Spar-Filled-Vug photograph independently inspected: irregular host, pale tapered triangular-faced crystals entering dark central cavity. Scalenohedral habit used as explicit geometric illustration, not spectroscopy or exact specimen reproduction. Image https://www.nps.gov/wica/learn/nature/images/Spar-Filled-Vug_Jason-Walz.JPG . Color and dimensions original.
